title: Rent Discount Rates for the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement recognises two rent discounts, each a fraction of the contracted monthly rent, and their rates differ by unit class.

| Unit class | Move-in discount on the first billing period's rent | Military discount on each billing period's rent |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 50% of the monthly rent | 10% of the monthly rent |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 50% of the monthly rent | 10% of the monthly rent |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 50% of the monthly rent | 10% of the monthly rent |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 50% of the monthly rent | 10% of the monthly rent |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 0% (no move-in discount) | 10% of the monthly rent |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 0% (no move-in discount) | 0% (no military discount) |

**How the two discounts combine on the first billing period (all classes):** the greater of the two applies; the move-in discount and the military discount are never added together on the first billing period.

## Terms

- **Move-in discount** — the discount on the first billing period's rent, expressed as a fraction of the monthly rent (50% means half off). A class shown at 0% has no move-in discount.
- **Military discount** — a standing discount on every billing period's rent for a tenant whose military discount is applied to the agreement, expressed as a fraction of the monthly rent.

## Points of reading

- In the Bluegate Climate Plus class, a tenant entitled to both discounts on the first billing period receives the 50% move-in discount, because it is the greater of 50% and 10%.
- In the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite class there is no move-in discount, so a tenant with the military discount applied receives 10% on the first billing period as on every other.
- The Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault carries neither discount.
